lead_headline: Microsoft 365 services restored after worldwide disruption
facebook_post:
Microsoft says Outlook, Teams and other affected services have recovered after a global outage. The more useful question is: what can your organisation still do when email and calendars disappear? Today’s Sapiver Forge Daily Brief examines that, plus Nvidia’s China strategy, AI-assisted analysis of Gödel’s notebooks and Tendrils’ $30m processor funding.

pinterest_title: Microsoft 365 outage: recovery and resilience lessons
pinterest_description: Services are restored, but organisations need independent fallbacks for essential communications. Read the evidence and analysis in Sapiver Forge Daily Brief. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
tiktok_caption: Microsoft 365 has recovered from a global outage. What breaks first when your team cannot use email or calendars? Evidence and practical fallbacks in today’s Sapiver Forge Daily Brief. #SapiverForge #CloudResilience #Technology
spoken_script: Microsoft says its affected Outlook, Teams and other services are restored after a global outage linked to a technical problem during a network-capacity change. It says there is no evidence of a cyberattack. The lesson: test independent ways to communicate and reach essential records. Read today’s Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
